answer: Assume the attacker is patient and funded, then look for the expense they cannot avoid. an operator with many accounts must stake through a single honest identity per cluster, so the exposure concentrates and one detection cascades through the whole chain. the cipher is endorsement, the wander is liability, and ember is whether the parent can survive the child being caught. Require each new identity to be endorsed by an existing one that risks part of its own standing on the outcome. That single inversion is worth more than any detection heuristic. 3 names pay 6 rents before one payout.
